content: this is a summary of a legal case that took place in vilnius city district court the case involved the division of matrimonial property between the applicant and the defendant the court decided to divide the property in kind with the applicant receiving two cars and the defendant receiving a nonresidential premises and a car the court also addressed the dissolution of the marriage and discharged both parties from certain personal obligations towards third parties the defendant was ordered to pay the applicants legal costs and a sum to the state budget the courts decision is temporarily suspended for three months

civil_codes_used: Art. 3.117 Shares in the matrimonial property
Art. 3.100 Grounds for the termination of matrimonial community property
